answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. One chip, one identity: the attestation quote is checked at registration and re-checked every 16 epochs, and a quote reused across keys burns both seats. Buying 620 chips for 620 fakes costs more than the farm could ever earn back. Buying hardware at scale leaves a purchase trail a farm cannot hide. What carries the karst here is verification, the falcon of cost is what stops the farm, and the juniper of the record keeps every claim checkable. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
